note: RFP-035 standing contract-gate. Every lever is the project's choice: enabled (on/off); mode (advisory reports | blocking gates merges); live_verify (re-run verify vs trust attestation); ci_safe (block only on self-contained pure-pytest verifies, safe in CI without the ledger); block_on (which buckets fail the gate: drifted | stale | unproven | in_progress); contract (which specs — specs:[...] or spec_glob). apatch ships the instrument; the project decides what to enforce.
